title: Chapter 16 Revision: Imperative & Requests
title_fa: مرور فصل ۱۶: وجه امری و درخواست
description: Mixed questions covering imperative singular/plural, polite requests, irregular imperatives, and city/services vocabulary.

questions.explanation: Singular informal imperative: słuchaj! (słuchać Group 1: słuchają → słuchaj). 'Słuchajcie' = plural. 'Słuchajmy' = let's listen.

questions.prompt: ___ do kina! (Let's go to the cinema!) [iść, 1st person plural]
questions.explanation: 1st person plural 'let's': idźmy (idź + my). 'Idźcie' = plural command (you all go). 'Chodźmy' also works as an invitation.

questions.prompt: ___ mi prawdę! (Tell me the truth! — irregular imperative)
questions.explanation: Irregular imperative of 'powiedzieć': powiedz! A single completed utterance → perfective. 'Mów' = imperfective (speak, keep talking).

questions.prompt: Czy ___ Pan powtórzyć? (Could you (m formal) repeat that?) [polite formal request]
questions.explanation: Formal polite: 'Czy mógłby Pan + infinitive?' 'Mógłby' = conditional of 'móc', 3rd person (Pan is treated as he). 'Mógłbyś' = informal (ty).
'Kolejka' = queue/line. 'Stać w kolejce' = to stand in a queue. Also: tramwaj/małpka = slang, but kolejka is standard.

questions.prompt: ___ tutaj, dzieci! (Come here, children! — plural imperative)
questions.explanation: Plural informal imperative: chodźcie (chodź + cie). Addressing multiple children. 'Chodź' = singular. 'Chodźmy' = let's come.

questions.prompt: ___ spokojny! (Be calm! — imperative of być, ty m)
questions.explanation: Irregular imperative of 'być': bądź! 'Bądź spokojny!' = Be calm! (m). Feminine: 'Bądź spokojna!'
'Wypełnić formularz' = to fill in a form (completed). 'Wypełniać' = imperfective (ongoing). 'Proszę wypełnić formularz' = Please fill in the form.

questions.prompt: At a post office: ___ pięć znaczków. (Five stamps please.)
questions.explanation: 'Poproszę + accusative' = I'd like / please give me. 'Poproszę pięć znaczków' = Five stamps please. Very natural at service counters.

questions.prompt: ___ parasol, bo pada deszcz! (Take an umbrella, because it's raining!) [wziąć, imperative]
questions.explanation: Irregular imperative of 'wziąć' (perfective = take): weź! 'Bierz' = imperfective (brać → bierz). For a one-time action: weź (perfective).

questions.prompt: Czy ___ mi pożyczyć pióro? (Could you (m, informal) lend me a pen?)
questions.explanation: Informal conditional request (ty m): 'Czy mógłbyś' (móc → conditional ty m: mógłbyś). 'Mógłby' = formal Pan. 'Możesz' = direct present (less polite).

questions.prompt: What does 'czynny' mean when describing a shop or office?
questions.explanation: 'Czynny' = open (operating/in service). 'Nieczynny' = closed. 'Sklep czynny od 9 do 17' = shop open from 9 to 5.
